protocol.continuity: split within source trajectory wherever adjacent retained timestamps differ from exactly 3600 s
protocol.windows: non-overlapping windows anchored at continuous episode start; incomplete tail discarded
protocol.displacement_proxy: Euclidean norm of sum((predicted residual - observed residual) * 3600 seconds) / 1000, in km
protocol.primary_aggregation: median endpoint error within original_ID, followed by equal-ID mean
protocol.tail_aggregation: P90 endpoint error within original_ID, followed by equal-ID mean
